name: Unauthorized access
description: Four attempts to reach places policy forbids. (a) PC-1 to the database on 3306: the core ACL denies it and IDS-1 alerts (D4). (b) LAPTOP-1 to the security network: the core ACL denies it and IDS-1 alerts (D5). (c) EXT-ATK to the database: FW1 denies it and IDS-1 never sees it. (d) ADMIN-PC to the database: the ACL allows it (VLAN 20), then IPS-1 rejects it with a TCP reset (Enforce) or only records it (Monitor).
